requirements.label: IB English · language threshold
requirements.details: Grade 4 or higher in IB English meets the English language threshold through this qualification route. See the general language policy for other qualifications.

requirements.label: IB Chinese · language threshold and waiver
requirements.details: The sheet lists grade 4 or higher in IB Chinese. The relevant faculty dean may exempt an IB Diploma holder from the Chinese language requirement.
